description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithSkill class in the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It tests the formatting of skill-related data retrieved from a test fixture file.

classes.name: FormatWithSkillTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithSkill component in OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and instantiates the FormatWithSkill object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the getFormattedValue method to ensure it correctly returns 'Driving' for ID 1 and null for ID 6.
